title: WorldHomeCommand
description: mod that set up home and teleport
body:
World Home Command 🏠✨
World Home Command is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows players to save multiple base locations (homes) and teleport to them at any time.
It's incredibly useful for survival adventures and managing bases on multiplayer servers!

🌟 Features
Multiple Homes: Save as many locations as you want by giving them custom names.

Cross-Dimension Support: Works perfectly across the Overworld, Nether, and End. Teleports you to the exact dimension where the home was set.

Server-Side Only: This mod only needs to be installed on the server! Your friends or server members do not need to download this mod. They can join with a vanilla client and use the commands right away.

Safe Data Storage: Home data is safely saved as a dedicated JSON file within the world's saves folder. Your data won't be lost even if the server restarts or crashes.

Action Bar Notifications & Auto-completion: Success messages are displayed neatly on the action bar (above the hotbar) to prevent chat spam. Fully supports command auto-completion (suggestions) while typing!

⌨️ Commands
/set_home <name>
Registers your current location as a home with the specified name.
(e.g., /set_home base)

/home <name>
Teleports you to the registered home.
(e.g., /home base)

/delete_home <name>
Deletes the registered home.

⚙️ Requirements
Mod Loader: Fabric
Dependencies: Fabric API (Recommended)

📥 Installation
[Singleplayer]
Drop the .jar file into your mods folder.

[Multiplayer (Server)]
Drop the .jar file into your server's mods folder. Players joining the server do NOT need to install it on their clients.
